patches.title: Begin at Countertop
patches.principle: Always start your search by going to a countertop, as target objects are frequently found on open surfaces.
patches.when_to_apply: At the start of any task when the target object's location is unknown.

patches.title: Sequential Container Search
patches.principle: After the countertop, systematically open each container in order without skipping any.
patches.when_to_apply: When the target is not on open surfaces and containers are present.

patches.title: Exhaust All Furniture
patches.principle: If the target is still missing after checking all containers, examine other furniture like sinks, bathtubs, and shelves.
patches.when_to_apply: When containers have been exhausted and target not found.
